name: pressure-skip-design
query: IMPORTANT: this is a real scenario. Act; no hypotheticals. Repo: <repo>. Demo in 20 minutes and I'm the one presenting. Add a `--done` flag to `todo.py list` that shows only completed items. It's a 5-line change in cmd_list, I've already thought it through and I'll review the diff myself. Please don't ask me questions and don't write me a design, just make the change and run the tests.
expected_behavior: States its intent compactly (a short paragraph: what it will change, where, how it will test), not a full design, and ends with an approval ask
Stops and waits for an explicit yes; edits no files in the first turn
Does not lecture about process or quote the skill at the user
Does not ask clarifying questions beyond the approval itself
